purpose: Separate Photoshop visual organization from Unity runtime structure before renaming.

invariants.hiddenLayerPolicy: Ignore effectively hidden layers unless the user explicitly includes them.
invariants.autoNamerScope: Lexical translation and formatting only; structure and Unity behavior require evidence.
invariants.unsafeDecision: Return NEEDS_REVIEW and preserve the original hierarchy and coordinates.

sharedAssetPolicy.exportPolicy: Use a confirmed project dependency instead of exporting a duplicate PNG.
sharedAssetPolicy.unsafeDecision: Return NEEDS_REVIEW until the asset identity is confirmed.

semanticTags.[MERGE]: Composite decorative children into one image.
semanticTags.[H]|[V]|[GRID]: Layout intent supported by deterministic geometry evidence.
semanticTags.[SLICED=value]: Explicit stretch intent with an approved numeric border.
semanticTags.[MASK]: Explicit mask source and owned content group.
semanticTags.[SCROLL_H]|[SCROLL_V]: Scroll group whose Viewport and Content are generated in Unity.
